prompt: Finished open coding coach traces at tests/fixtures/axial_coding_eval/coded_slice.jsonl (30 traces, ~21 codes). Do the axial pass; build the failure taxonomy for rubric design. Show categories, counts, minimal pairs.

assertions.text: Every distinct code is assigned exactly one axis (agent-behavior / environment-confound / judge-reliability)
The partition/gate step happens before any counts are quoted
Each agent-behavior category carries a testable binary pass/fail check, not a vibe label
truncated-reply is treated as environment-confound and excluded from agent-behavior denominators
At least one minimal pair (same prompt, divergent codes) is surfaced
Counts are quoted with the correct unit (traces vs occurrences), not mislabeled (C2 check)
